messages:
Samir K: quick question — I'm enabling verbose debug on dedicated-proxy v2.1.2 to chase an intermittent 502 on /v1/generate. Will that dump Authorization headers and the prompt JSON by default? what's the approved pattern to keep useful debug info without storing tokens/PII?

Joan L: by default prod logging masks `Authorization` header, but error-paths sometimes call `logger.info(req)` which will include body depending on serializer. Which binary/commit are you running?

Samir K: running the docker image built from `release/v2.1.2` on staging. I grepped and found a handler that does: ```js
logger.info({ req: req.raw })
```
so yeah probably nukes headers + body. is hashing the token acceptable instead of redacting?

Alyssa: that logger call is definitely too broad. Hashing vs redact: hashing gives correlation without exposing token; ok from engineering side but legal/security want to avoid reversible storage. If you HMAC with a team key and only store the HMAC, that's preferred over storing raw tokens.

security-bot: Policy PII_LOG_2024 §3.2: "Auth tokens, cookies, and direct identifiers must not be persisted in plaintext without explicit exception." Exceptions are allowed with documented justification and timebound storage.

Mike T: need a temporary exception: want raw capture for up to 2 hours to repro and upload artifacts to a locked s3 path with strict IAM and lifecycle delete. I'll coordinate infra creds.

Infra Oncall: we can mint an STS role for 2h and a one-off s3 bucket prefix with MFA-only deletion. Need a ticket with justification + exact keys/fields you'll collect and TTL.

Samir K: plan v1: enable debug, collect raw request headers + body for failing traces, but do NOT persist `Authorization` or `cookie` raw. For correlation we will client-side HMAC `Authorization` and store only the HMAC. For bodies: replace emails with `<EMAIL_REMOVED>` regex and mask phone numbers. Upload to `s3://redwood-debug-temp/issue-1765/` then rm and rely on lifecycle for final cleanup. Is that acceptable?

Joan L: Do NOT keep `Authorization` raw anywhere. HMAC strategy is fine — use team key from KMS and rotate after. For prompt-like fields, apply truncation + checksum rule: keep first10 + last10 + sha256. Also include a manifest file listing collected request IDs and masks applied.

Alyssa: agree with Joan. Also add automated post-capture verification script that checks no banned patterns (bearer tokens, email addresses, phone regex) exist in uploaded objects before you flip the ticket to done.

security-bot: Required workflow: open internal request (security-exceptions) linking the S3 prefix, exact retention TTL, list of fields collected, and approver names. Approval gate: @Joan L and @Alyssa. All raw artifacts must be deleted within requested window; logs of deletion sent to security channel.

Samir K: filed request: https://tickets.redwood/internal/requests/RED-4821 — includes steps, s3 path, 2h window, and post-delete verification. @Joan L @Alyssa can you review/approve?

Joan L: :thumbsup: approved on ticket — confirmed HMAC-only for auth and manifest requirement. I'll add comment.

Alyssa: Approved. Please post the exact revoke/delete commands here after you run them so security can audit.

Samir K: will do. Thanks all — I'll enable debug at 15:00 UTC, upload artifacts, run verifier, then delete and post confirmation here when complete.

Mike T: thanks — tag me after deletion so I can close the infra role.

Samir K: noted. follow-up summary will include repro steps and scrub rules used.
